rule.origin: Original boards: first roster entry must be waiver/FA — drafted-then-dropped claims are out.
rule.any_claim: Any claim → today: every waiver/FA add counts, including drafted-then-dropped reclamations.
rule.metric_today: calculator today (flatten + market blend) − pickup flatten
rule.metric_peak: peak flatten after pickup − pickup flatten
rule.order: Biggest lift first; one row per player. Same value scale as Trade Value / calculator.
